Name: Less Annoying Flowers
Author: inmognito
Description:
The flower colour/inventory problem was annoying me so I wrote a tiny content patcher thing in 15 minutes to make it go away.
[i]
Please note that this mod affects seeds as at the time of planting.  i.e. any config change will affect seeds planted after the config has been changed.

[b]LATEST CHANGE (1.2.0)
[/b][/i][list]
[*]Individual flower types can now be opted out of using a single colour.
[*]Individual flower types can be set to 'custom' and have their colour overridden by entering an RGB value (e.g. 255 0 0 to tint a flower red)

[/list]
[b]Installation
[/b][list=1]
[*]Download the mod
[*]Extract the zip and paste into your mod folder
[*]The first time you run the game, a config file will be created.  You can use this to choose a new flower colour scheme or add custom colours if you want.

[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b][i]
[/i][list]
[*]Compatible with most things because it has almost no moving parts.
[*]In particular it's compatible with replacements of flower assets such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks [/url]﻿and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4912]Better Crops and Forage[/url]﻿
[/list][i]
[/i][b]Now with config file[/b] that lets you choose from a handful of colour schemes for your flowers.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Less annoying flowers
Manifest.Description: All the flowers now have a single colour each. Your inventory will be thankful.
